Class 2 · Chapter 7 of 9

Shop, save and find change

Make amounts with notes and coins, find change and keep track of savings.

  1. See it
  2. Try it
  3. Practise it
  4. Print it
  5. Check it

This chapter works best after Clocks, dates and how long. You can still look around, or jump to the check.

By the end I can…

  • I can make an amount with notes and coins.
  • I can find a missing price or change.
  • I can compare purchases within a budget.

1 See it

Screen 1 of 4

Coins and notes

Rs 1, Rs 2, Rs 5 and Rs 10 can be coins. Rs 10, Rs 20 and Rs 50 can be notes.

Count the biggest first, then add the smaller ones.

Screen 2 of 4

Make an amount

To make Rs 27, start with a Rs 20 note.

Add a Rs 5 coin and a Rs 2 coin. 20 + 5 + 2 = 27.

Screen 3 of 4

Find the change

A toy costs Rs 35. You pay with a Rs 50 note.

Change is what is left: 50 − 35 = 15.

Screen 4 of 4

Spend and save

You have Rs 50 saved. You spend Rs 18.

Take away: 50 − 18 = 32. You still have Rs 32.

Words to know
change
The money you get back when you pay more than the price.
price
How much something costs.
savings
Money you keep for later instead of spending.

For parents

What your child learns

To find change, add up the cost and take it from the money paid. If items cost different amounts, multiply each price by how many, then add. Packs can be cheaper than singles.

A common slip

Children may forget to multiply by the number of items. Write each line as price times number, then add. Subtract from the money paid last.

5-minute home activity: Play shop

  1. Make price tags on paper, such as Rs 5 and Rs 8.
  2. Buy 3 of one item and 2 of another.
  3. Add the total and take it from Rs 60.
  4. Compare buying 10 singles with buying a pack.
